diagnosis.root_cause: Static inspection shows an existing hand-written training encounter, not an established absence of enemy code: training_monster.gd implements pursuit, timed attacks, HP and death, while sword_training.gd separately owns contact, defense, rewards and recovery. These live paths do not yet implement the operator-selected Snaiel foundation. Snaiel supplies concrete attack-instance deduplication, damage windows, health signals and enemy/blackboard mechanisms, but its original scenes depend on Blender imports, demo Globals and additional animation/navigation systems. The required increment is a substantive compatible replacement inside the existing encounter. Ordinary-input reachability, audiovisual quality and performance are unverified; the inherited context reports below-target Forest frame rates.

tasks.instructions: Anchor this replacement to PRD 3.2–3.3, 3.7, 4.2–4.5, 5.2, 6.1–6.2 and 7.1, and the frozen foundation review. The current ledger has no active findings; the missing observation is independent proof of the selected template executing in the connected candidate. Preserve the seed instead of restarting from a template. Read the selected source revision and actual dependency references through authorized standalone source operations. Copy and adapt substantial Snaiel health, hitbox, damage resources, melee/animation-event components, hit handling and enemy/behavior wiring. Destination responsibilities: combat/snaiel owns the imported mechanisms; TrainingMonster.tscn and training_monster.gd bind the existing Orc and encounter to them; sword_training.gd retains acquisition, teaching eligibility, defense rules, checkpoint/reward policy and adapters; bow_training.gd forwards resolved arrow contacts; player_controller.gd retains input, collider motion, camera and calibrated village mounts. dialogue_state.gd remains persistent quest/player-HP/lives/reward authority; the adopted HealthComponent owns enemy HP. Remove the replaced monster timer/HP loop and duplicate sword hit-deduplication/damage paths after switching bindings. Use product policy adapters before applying damage, then emit one resolved result for HP readouts, reaction, feedback and lethal handling. Keep tutorial simulated attacks nonlethal and successful block or dodge sufficient for progression; optional parry cannot become a new prerequisite. Source MeleeAnimations/BaseAnimations and enemy Globals are incompatible with the current animation driver and product globals: adapt their signal/event interfaces to existing imported clips and dependency injection, retaining substantive mechanisms rather than rewriting a cosmetic imitation. If retaining Beehave branches, include their used runtime dependency closure; adapt away unneeded editor icons/debugger dependencies explicitly. Resolve class names, res:// paths, groups, masks and navigation on real Forest ground.

investigation.expected_observation: The imported components execute under ordinary controls with one HP mutation per accepted attack instance, one lethal transition and one reward claim, while the existing actor, pause and save interfaces remain intact. Parser errors, a missing route, duplicate deltas or stale attacks discriminate an incomplete closure or ownership conflict.
